revision.description: Cortina marks that belong to the track, and a record of each play TangoQ logs to history: the history session (playlist_id), the track, when it started, its role at the time (0 regular, 1 cortina, 2 performance) and whether LIVE mode was on.
The tanda each play was part of: its id, type (0 tango, 1 vals, 2 milonga, 3 nuevo or alternative), name, and the track position in it out of its size. Empty for a track outside a tanda.
